reward_identity.fc_lifecycle: environment-managed running includes zero-output idle; one complete start-stop cycle is settled only at shutdown
reward_identity.terminal_shutdown: zero duration; FC/LB outputs zero; SOC and battery Ah unchanged; terminal transient enters the final normal reward; cycle cost stays in physical accounting only
reward_identity.fc_degradation_cost_allocation: raw interval voltage-loss proportions of the original EOL-capped ledger cost; start/stop excluded only from reward
reward_identity.fc_start_stop_reward_scope: Low-load, high-load and cycle degradation are reported in physical costs only. The reward uses the existing transient cost, including the terminal transient once.
reward_identity.battery_equivalent_hydrogen_sign: Signed CNY reporting only. Discharge is positive and charge is negative.
reward_identity.battery_equivalence: Signed SOC cell-energy delta / fixed eta_fc_avg / LHV, without applying battery efficiency twice.

physical_accounting_identity.fc_lifecycle: environment-managed running includes zero-output idle; one complete start-stop cycle is settled only at shutdown
physical_accounting_identity.terminal_shutdown: zero duration; FC/LB outputs zero; SOC and battery Ah unchanged; terminal transient enters the final normal reward; cycle cost stays in physical accounting only
physical_accounting_identity.fc_degradation_cost_allocation: raw interval voltage-loss proportions of the original EOL-capped ledger cost; start/stop excluded only from reward
physical_accounting_identity.battery_equivalence: signed SOC cell-energy delta / fixed eta_fc_avg / LHV; Zhou Eq. (25), k=1; no extra battery/DC-DC efficiency
